name: Los Angeles
tagline: The creative capital of the Pacific.
description: Los Angeles is a sprawling, multi-nodal metropolis defined by its diverse neighborhoods, world-class culinary enclaves, and deep entertainment history. Visitors are drawn by the convergence of dramatic coastal geography, cutting-edge art institutions, and the most dynamic immigrant food culture in North America.

identity.vibe: A sun-drenched, sprawling mosaic of intense creative ambition and laid-back coastal detachment, where a Tuesday lunch in a strip mall can be the best meal of your life.

nexus_grid.title: Entertainment & Theme Parks
nexus_grid.description: The Hollywood/Universal City corridor remains the primary gravitational pull for international and first-time domestic visitors.

nexus_grid.title: Neighborhood Culinary Culture
nexus_grid.description: A sprawling network of ethnic enclaves offering the most diverse and high-quality food scene in the nation — SGV Chinese, Koreatown, Thai Town, Oaxacan, and chef-driven new wave.

nexus_grid.title: Coastal Lifestyle & Wellness
nexus_grid.description: The quintessential California dream — 75 miles of coastline from Malibu to Long Beach, surf culture, and Korean spa wellness.

modes.label: Foodie
modes.description: LA's food scene is the best and most diverse in the US — from $3 taco trucks to three-Michelin-star tasting menus.

modes.label: Coastal & Chill
modes.description: Slow paces only. Third-wave coffee, natural wine, beach sunsets, and Korean spas.

modes.label: Nightlife
modes.description: Comedy clubs, speakeasies, live music on the Sunset Strip, rooftop bars, and K-Town karaoke.

modes.label: Arts & Architecture
modes.description: Massive 2026 museum openings, mid-century architecture, gallery walks, and cultural landmarks.

modes.label: Adventure & Outdoors
modes.description: Surf Malibu, hike to the Hollywood Sign, bike 22 miles of coastline, catch a World Cup match.

modes.label: Family
modes.description: Theme parks, free museums, beaches, and food that kids and parents actually want to eat.

modes.label: Romantic
modes.description: Sunset at Griffith, omakase for two, Hollywood Bowl picnics, and sea caves at golden hour.

modes.label: Studio & Entertainment
modes.description: The classic industry experience: studio tours, WeHo nightlife, celebrity haunts, and live tapings.

modes.label: Koreatown
modes.description: KBBQ, 24/7 spas, karaoke noraebangs, late-night bars — a city within a city that never closes.

modes.label: World Cup 2026
modes.description: LA hosts 8 FIFA World Cup matches at SoFi Stadium. Fan Festival at the Coliseum. The biggest sporting event of the decade.

transit.local_transport: Historically car-dependent, but rapidly evolving for the 2028 Olympics via the 'Twenty-Eight by 28' transit initiative. Metro Rail expanding aggressively — E Line runs DTLA to Santa Monica, D Line extending to Beverly Hills/Miracle Mile museum corridor. LAX Automated People Mover eliminates terminal traffic. Uber/Lyft essential for cross-city trips. Walkable pockets: Santa Monica, West Hollywood, DTLA, Venice/Abbot Kinney, Old Pasadena. Metro Day Pass: $3.50 unlimited. Scooters and bikes in beach communities.

_legacy_transit.label: Drive
_legacy_transit.text: From Las Vegas: 270 miles via I-15 S (4-5 hours). From San Diego: 120 miles via I-5 N (2-3 hours). From San Francisco: 380 miles via I-5 S (6 hours) or scenic Highway 101.

_legacy_transit.label: Train
_legacy_transit.text: Amtrak Pacific Surfliner offers 13 daily roundtrips from San Diego to LA Union Station (codeshare with Metrolink). Coast Starlight connects from SF/Seattle. Metrolink provides extensive regional commuter rail.

_legacy_transit.label: Fly
_legacy_transit.text: LAX (global hub, newly modernized with Automated People Mover launching 2026 connecting to Metro), BUR (Burbank — optimal for Hollywood/Eastside, easy in-out), LGB (Long Beach — great for South Bay/JetBlue), SNA (John Wayne — best for Disneyland/OC), ONT (Ontario — Inland Empire access).

side_trips.name: Joshua Tree National Park
side_trips.pitch: Surreal desert landscape where the Mojave and Colorado deserts meet. Rock formations, Joshua trees, and some of the darkest night skies near any major city.

side_trips.name: Santa Barbara
side_trips.pitch: The American Riviera — red-tile roofs, Spanish colonial architecture, and elite wine country.

side_trips.name: Palm Springs
side_trips.pitch: Mid-century modern architecture, natural hot springs, and a scene that runs from boutique hotels to pool parties.

side_trips.name: Catalina Island
side_trips.distance: 1 hr ferry from San Pedro / Long Beach
side_trips.pitch: A Mediterranean-style island escape just off the coast. No cars, crystal-clear water, and small-town charm.

side_trips.name: Big Bear Lake
side_trips.pitch: Mountain escape at 6,750 ft. Ski in winter, kayak in summer. The antidote to LA's flatlands.

concierge.name: The Eastside Connect
concierge.greeting: Yo. Welcome to the actual LA. Skip the Walk of Fame and let me show you where we really eat, drink, and live.

_legacy.hero_sub: Navigate the coastal marine layer into sun-baked afternoons in the hills. Summer in LA is defined by outdoor movie screenings, beach days in Malibu, and twilight concerts at the Hollywood Bowl.
